method: Created a fresh Python 3.14.7 virtual environment from the pinned macOS ARM64 lock, then ran the dependency-free audit script with that interpreter. It compiled and executed both complete Python fences and checked the displayed retry trace and scope statements.

observations.trace: The complete second example recorded 3 work-node executions and test-list users [u2, u2, u2] after a same-process injected exception and a subsequent invoke on the same thread.

limitations: The fixture writes to a Python list; it does not test a database, network side effect, production checkpointer, parallel nodes, or an actual process termination/restart.
No model provider was called. The lesson now states that its first graph is a workflow skeleton, not a complete Agent loop.
The historical 2026-10-09 environment was not captured by a complete dependency lock; this run is a separate reproduction using the pinned 2026-10-21 environment.
Official LangGraph documentation supports the checkpoint/task semantics; the local run does not establish production exactly-once behavior.
